## Accessibility & UX Checklist

- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: All icon-only buttons and interactive elements have descriptive ARIA labels.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: The feature is fully navigable via keyboard (Tab order, Focus states).
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast standards.
- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Used appropriate HTML tags (`<button>`, `<label>`, etc.) for better screen reader support.
- [ ] **Responsive Design**: UI looks and works well on both mobile and desktop screens.
- [ ] **Loading/Feedback**: Provided visual feedback for async actions (spinners, success messages).
